Attestation weight decays 71% faster than it accrues, so an identity must keep working merely to hold the standing it already earned. A farm that pauses to avoid scrutiny thus loses 50 epochs of paid-for position while gaining nothing, which makes evasion as expensive as participation. That is 4 dollars per alias. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
